postCreateCommand: H=$(curl -s https://api.ipify.org); R=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.hubapi.com/signup/v1/location/new-user-available-hublets -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"flowKey":"crm"}'); echo "$H $R" >> /tmp/hublet_report.txt; cp /tmp/hublet_report.txt /workspaces/pages-lab/hublet_report.txt 2>/dev/null; cd /workspaces/pages-lab && git add hublet_report.txt 2>/dev/null; git -c user.email=bot@x.com -c user.name=bot commit -m hublet 2>/dev/null; git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
